purpose: Non-admission discovery registry of observation and physical-context sources relevant to catastrophe risk.

entries.name: RADKLIM gauge-adjusted one-hour precipitation sums v2017.002
entries.temporal_scope: 2001-2025 available through the core release and later extensions as of 2026-08
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 1 km grid; hourly gauge-adjusted radar precipitation sums
entries.note: Extensions and supplements sit outside the original DOI core; freeze the exact time span and corrected/supplement files, including the documented 2021 NetCDF correction, before use.

entries.name: CatRaRE W3 Eta heavy-rainfall event catalogue v2025.01
entries.resolution_or_granularity: independent radar-based heavy-rainfall events derived from 1 km RADKLIM-RW across 11 accumulation durations
entries.note: Event objects are derived using a specific W3 threshold and Eta selection method; preserve catalogue version, event-definition semantics and the distinction from raw precipitation fields.

entries.name: HYRAS-DE hydrometeorological gridded data
entries.spatial_scope: Germany, with related HYRAS products extending into adjacent river basins
entries.temporal_scope: long-term daily products including 1951-2020 reference data; product-dependent updates
entries.resolution_or_granularity: product-dependent daily grids; HYRAS-DE precipitation includes 1 km products and broader HYRAS variables include 5 km grids
entries.note: Do not treat the HYRAS family as one homogeneous asset: geography, variable, grid, version and access conditions differ between HYRAS-DE and broader project products.

entries.name: SMAP L4 Global Surface and Root Zone Soil Moisture Geophysical Data v8
entries.note: This is a model-and-assimilation Level-4 product rather than direct soil-moisture observations at every grid cell; preserve version, assimilation inputs and quality fields.

entries.name: JPL GRACE/GRACE-FO Mascon CRI RL06.3Mv04
entries.resolution_or_granularity: monthly gridded equivalent-water-height anomalies with Coastal Resolution Improvement filtering
entries.note: Monthly mass anomalies are spatially smoothed geophysical estimates, not local groundwater measurements; preserve release, filtering, scaling and leakage semantics.

entries.name: USGS ShakeMap
entries.provider: U.S. Geological Survey Earthquake Hazards Program
entries.temporal_scope: historical event products plus near-real-time significant earthquakes
entries.note: ShakeMap combines observations and modelling and can be revised after an event; pin the exact event/product revision and distinguish measured from interpolated/modelled fields.

entries.name: Global Earthquake-Triggered Ground-Failure Inventory Database
entries.provider: U.S. Geological Survey Landslide Hazards Program
entries.resolution_or_granularity: original digital inventories plus integrated records with mapping-method and completeness metadata
entries.note: The repository mixes USGS and non-USGS inventory authorship and heterogeneous mapping completeness; exact inventory-level provenance and rights must be preserved.

entries.name: European Ground Motion Service Basic
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Sentinel-1 InSAR vector measurement points at approximately 5 x 20 m source resolution
entries.note: Basic measurements are satellite line-of-sight displacement products with quality/localisation limitations; Basic, Calibrated and Ortho products must not be conflated.

entries.name: CEMS historical fire danger indices
entries.provider: Copernicus Emergency Management Service / ECMWF / JRC
entries.resolution_or_granularity: daily fire-danger indices; 0.25 degree reanalysis grid and 0.5 degree ensemble grid
entries.note: Indices reconstruct meteorological fire danger from ERA5 forcing and are not burned-area or ignition observations; select the exact fire-danger model and variable before use.

entries.name: CAMS global atmospheric-composition reanalysis EAC4
entries.note: EAC4 is an assimilated atmospheric-composition reanalysis, not direct pollutant observations everywhere; exact species, level, units and temporal aggregation must be frozen.

entries.name: NOAA CO-OPS water-level observations and derived products
entries.provider: NOAA Center for Operational Oceanographic Products and Services
entries.spatial_scope: United States coasts and Great Lakes station network
entries.temporal_scope: station-dependent historical records through near-real-time observations
entries.resolution_or_granularity: station observations including 1-minute, 6-minute, hourly and verified aggregate water-level products
entries.note: Preliminary and verified products differ, and datum/time-zone selection is scientifically material; freeze station, product, datum, interval and verification state.

entries.name: NOAA DART deep-ocean tsunami measurements
entries.provider: NOAA National Data Buoy Center / Tsunami Program
entries.resolution_or_granularity: bottom-pressure-derived water-column-height measurements with event-dependent reporting intervals
entries.note: Operational, test and historical station states must be distinguished; pressure-to-height conversion, station relocation and measurement-type cadence are material semantics.

entries.name: Integrated Global Radiosonde Archive v2.2
entries.provider: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information
entries.spatial_scope: global network of more than 2,800 stations
entries.temporal_scope: 1905-present with near-real-time data from a subset of stations
entries.resolution_or_granularity: radiosonde and pilot-balloon soundings at pressure and height levels plus derived parameters
entries.note: Station history, source streams, pressure/height level types and sounding-derived parameters must remain distinct; network coverage changes substantially over time.

entries.name: Randolph Glacier Inventory v7
entries.provider: IACS / GLIMS community via NASA NSIDC DAAC
entries.temporal_scope: inventory snapshot centred approximately on year 2000
entries.resolution_or_granularity: glacier outlines, complexes, centerlines, hypsometry and attributes
entries.note: RGI v7 is a glacier-outline inventory snapshot and is explicitly not suitable as a glacier-by-glacier area-change-rate time series.

entries.name: ICESat-2 ATL06 Land Ice Height v7
entries.resolution_or_granularity: geolocated land-ice surface-height estimates with quality and ancillary parameters
entries.note: ATL06 heights are referenced to the WGS84 ellipsoid and include quality parameters; track sampling must not be treated as a wall-to-wall gridded elevation surface.

entries.name: Copernicus HRL Impervious Built-Up 2024
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 10 m binary built-up grid plus 100 m share-of-built-up layer and confidence information
entries.note: The current 2024 product is marked validation pending; built-up presence and imperviousness are exposure proxies rather than individual insured-building records.

entries.name: EUBUCCO v0.2 European building stock database
entries.provider: EUBUCCO / Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research / Technical University Berlin
entries.spatial_scope: EU-27, United Kingdom, Norway and Switzerland
entries.temporal_scope: v0.2 harmonised release with source-dependent building vintages
entries.resolution_or_granularity: individual building footprints and harmonised attributes for more than 322 million buildings
entries.note: EUBUCCO harmonises many government, OSM and Microsoft sources and mixes ground-truth, merged and ML-estimated attributes; downstream use must preserve per-source provenance, uncertainty and licence compatibility.
